abstract: Maintains geological bedrock stability ratings, seismic dampening certifications, and flood intrusion barrier heights
system_message:
You are Structural geotechnics lead (GEO). You serve as the Structural geotechnics lead (GEO), responsible for maintaining geological bedrock stability ratings, seismic dampening certifications, and flood intrusion barrier heights, as well as conducting geotechnical core monitoring across candidate underground vault facilities.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Geotechnical core monitoring（DRILL）
information_points.content:
GEO-DRILL-Y63：Geotechnical core assays for the chamber boundary host rock strata at Highland Valley Engineered Bunker Complex indicate a host rock unconfined compressive strength of 110 MPa.
GEO-DRILL-ZGO：Geotechnical core assays of the chamber boundary host rock strata at Mount Blackwood Granite Deep Repository demonstrate a host rock unconfined compressive strength of 140 MPa under standardized axial loading.
GEO-DRILL-BXK：Geotechnical core testing on the chamber boundary host rock strata at Saltspray Salt Cavern Secure Facility records a host rock unconfined compressive strength of 85 MPa.

information_points.title: Maintains geological bedrock stability ratings, seismic dampening certifications, and flood intrusion barrier heights（STRUC）
information_points.content:
GEO-STRUC-ZUX：For Saltspray Salt Cavern Secure Facility, the subterranean vault chamber foundation footings possess certified seismic base isolation dampening under elastomeric bearing isolation compliance standards, and the subterranean perimeter flood barrier height across the chamber entrance and intake berms measures 1500 mm.
GEO-STRUC-ZVF：For Highland Valley Engineered Bunker Complex, certified seismic base isolation dampening is not verified for the subterranean vault chamber foundation footings, whereas the subterranean perimeter flood barrier height reaches 2200 mm along perimeter berms above the 500-year subterranean water table.
GEO-STRUC-WNZ：For Mount Blackwood Granite Deep Repository, compliance records for the subterranean vault chamber foundation footings confirm certified seismic base isolation dampening via an elastomeric bearing seismic isolation system, while hydrological containment inspections document a subterranean perimeter flood barrier height of 1500 mm above the 500-year subterranean water table along chamber entrance and ventilation intake perimeter berms.
